Key points from the transcript:
1. 6·3 local elections and by-elections are underway at 14,000+ polling stations nationwide
2. As of 11 AM, voter turnout is 15% (6.69 million voters), which is 3% higher than the same time in 2020 and 2022 general elections
3. Regional differences: Daegu highest at 18.9%, Gwangju/Jeonnam lowest at 11.4%
4. Early voting recorded highest ever at 23.51% (14.9 million voters)
5. Voting ends at 6 PM, results expected around midnight
6. Important notes: Must vote at registered address, receive ballots in two separate batches (3 first, then 2-3 more depending on region), no photography inside voting booths
